metadata.title: Yang-Mills-Higgs-Schrödinger flow
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we initiate the study of the Yang-Mills-Higgs-Schrödinger(YMHS) flow, i.e. the Hamiltonian flow of the Yang-Mills-Higgs functional defined on a symplectic fiber bundle. The YMHS flow provides a natural gauge-theoretic extension of the classical Schrödinger flow within the framework of symplectic reduction theory, and generalizes the Chern-Simons-Schrödinger equations to a non-Abelian gauge and non-linear fiber setting. We study its geometric structures and establish the local well-posedness of the corresponding Cauchy problem on compact Riemann surfaces.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 提出 Yang--Mills--Higgs--Schrödinger 流，将经典 Schrödinger 流扩展到非阿贝尔规范与非线性纤维的辛约化框架。
analysis.breakthrough: 建立几何结构并证明紧 Riemann 曲面上 Cauchy 问题的局部适定性。
analysis.limitations: 目前仅为局部理论且基底是紧曲面；长时间行为和奇点尚未处理。
